modules.title: Unit 1
topics: solution of LP for two variables
Simplex method, special cases of LP- transportation and assignment model and their graphical solution
Vogels Approximation Method (VAM) or penalty method, cell evaluation degeneracy, basics of SW Lindo

modules.title: Supply chain (SCM): Definition, importance, expenditure and opportunities in SCM
topics: integrationof inbound, outbound logistics and manufacturing to SCM, flow of material money and information,difficulties in SCM due to local v/s system wide (global) optimization and uncertainties in demand andtransportation
transportation,cross docking and distribution, forecasting models in SCM; coordination and leadership issues
changeof purchasing role and vendor rating, variability from multiple suppliers.

modules.title: Unit 3
topics: basics of inventory models with deterministic demand
ABC, VED and other analysis based on shelf life, movement, size
MRP technique and calculations, lot sizing in MRP, linking MRP with JIT; evolution of MRP to ERP to SCM and e-business.

modules.title: a) Waiting Line Models: Introduction, Input process, service mechanism, Queue

basic multipleserver models (M/M/s) (b) Competitive strategy: concept and terminology, assumptions, pure and mixed strategies, two- person zero sumgames, saddle point, dominance, graphical, algebraic and LP methods for solving game theory problems.
